name: Tajima Ramen
_themeNote: v2 reverses the v1 'night is permanent' rule: light and dark both ship, day is the default, and the toggle is manual (no clock, no prefers-color-scheme). `mode` here is the server-rendered default and the no-JS answer; _includes/components/theme-init.njk corrects it from localStorage before first paint. Pages not yet migrated to the v2 ramp pin `mode: night` in their own front matter; those pins come off per Phase 4 batch.
_statsNote: Same rule as the footer spec strip. The reference concept's home stat bar read '8 Ramen houses' and '12h Tonkotsu simmer'. Both are corrected here: CLIENT_FACTS.md forbids publishing a global location total, and no simmer time is confirmed anywhere. Do not revert.
_sloganNote: EXACT STRING, per DESIGN_SYSTEM.md 'Copy constants'. 'Housemade' is one word with no hyphen, a deliberate exception to the house-made spelling in voice-tone.md. Do not 'correct' it, and do not correct other instances to match. OPEN, ONE CLIENT ANSWER RESOLVES ALL SEVEN: 'crafted daily' and its siblings assert a noodle cadence that CLIENT_FACTS.md does not confirm (it confirms the daily cadence for the BROTH only). Five templates carry a comment explaining why the claim was written out of their copy: src/locations.njk, src/about.njk, src/noodle-room.njk, src/tajima-convoy.njk, and formerly src/index.njk (its comment annotated a section the v2 rebuild removed; the caution is restated at the top of the new file). Two live claims now publish the cadence and are the ones to re-check first: src/index.njk trio card 'Cut daily in the Noodle Room', and src/index.njk locations lede 'cut that morning in Crown Point'. Ask Sam how often noodles are actually cut, then either confirm all seven or rewrite them together.
_footerRenderNote: footer.epitaph and footer.spec are NO LONGER RENDERED. The footer was trimmed to slogan, nav and colophon because the epitaph and the slogan were two taglines doing one job and the spec strip repeated facts stated in body copy elsewhere (all four verified present on other pages before removal). The data and its provenance notes are kept deliberately: the figures are hard-won and _specNote records why two of them differ from the concept. Do not delete them, and do not re-add the blocks without a reason to.
